subject: Partner-led discovery: Redwood <> CloudBridge — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Partner-led discovery: Redwood <> CloudBridge — next steps

Hi Nina / team,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — great to learn more about CloudBridge's marketplace and where you see a fit for a Redwood integration. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap:
- Primary use case: CloudBridge wants a low-latency hosted inference option for marketplace customers with predictable SLAs and a streamlined onboarding flow.
- Key technical concerns: VPC peering, KMS integration for customer-managed keys, data residency options, and quantization/latency trade-offs.
- Stakeholders: Nina (PM, marketplace), Evan (solutions/ops), plus your solution architect for the technical deep dive.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive / demo (partner-led) — go through architecture, auth options, and marketplace onboarding flow.
2) Follow-up: draft mutual action plan + integration checklist (we can propose a timeline afterward).

Availability: we can do a 60–75 minute technical session next week. Are you available any of the following slots (PST)?
- Mon Apr 4: 10:00–11:30am
- Tue Apr 5: 2:00–3:30pm

If neither works, send a couple windows that fit your team and we’ll coordinate. I’ve attached a short recap deck and a tentative agenda for the deep dive. Laura will lead the demo and cover latency/cost examples; Mateo will join to discuss the marketplace listing/ops flow.

Attachments: Redwood-CloudBridge-recap.pdf (summary), Technical-Deep-Dive-Agenda.pdf (agenda)

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Zhou <evan.zhou@cloudbridge.com>, solutions@cloudbridge.com
Date: 2027-03-30T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: Redwood <> CloudBridge — next steps

Thanks Marissa — great recap and thanks to your team for the clear notes. Evan and I confirmed internally; we can do Mon Apr 4 at 10:00am PT. Evan will loop in our Solution Architect (cc’d via solutions@) — we want them in the deep dive to run through the VPC/KMS details.

A couple asks so Laura can tailor the demo:
- Can you include a short slide or demo segment on private key management options (KMS/HSM)?
- We’d like to see a quick example of how you handle prefix/KV caching for high-volume marketplace tenants.

We’ll send a calendar invite from our side once you confirm the final attendee list. Looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Nina Patel
Product Manager, Marketplace | CloudBridge
Nina.Patel@cloudbridge.com

Perfect — Apr 4 at 10:00am PT is locked. I’ll send a calendar invite with the detailed agenda and a Google Meet link; Laura will cover KMS options and caching/latency trade-offs, and Mateo will cover the marketplace listing flow and ops requirements.

Pre-reads / links:
- Technical deep dive agenda: https://drive.google.com/file/d/technical-deep-dive-agenda
- Shared folder with partner materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cloudbridge-partner-materials

I’ve also added a short list of architecture topics we can prioritize: auth & tokens, VPC peering options, customer key management, and rollout/rollback strategy for marketplace customers. If there’s anything else Evan wants on the agenda, flag it and we’ll include it.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-cloudbridge-deepdive-20270404

See you all on Apr 4.

Thanks,
Marissa
